purpose: Separate accepted commercial terms, contract lifecycle execution, invoice/payment readiness, payment observation and service-delivery authorization without creating any of them.

required_evidence: applicable contract requires execution lifecycle transition
applicable accepted/executed terms establish an amount or deterministic billing basis
invoice/AR evidence owner admitted when invoice is required
authentic provider/financial evidence of payment or receivable settlement
amount/currency attributable to exact engagement/invoice or accepted payment obligation

SERVICE_DELIVERY_AUTHORIZED.owner: applicable offering transaction boundary plus separately admitted operational owner
required_evidence: customer source/data authority satisfied where required
required contract/deposit/payment condition satisfied only when the offering terms require it
professional/regulatory/provider/runtime dependencies separately satisfied where applicable
an authentic delivery owner/admission path exists

topology.rule: States are not automatically transitive. CONTRACT_OR_SOW_ACCEPTED does not imply any downstream state.
topology.contract_execution: When the engagement requires StegBusiness-Ops contract execution, CONTRACT_LIFECYCLE_EXECUTED is separately observed. Acceptance alone cannot synthesize EXECUTED.
topology.finance: INVOICE_OR_PAYMENT_TERMS_READY is evidence/readiness only. Invoice issuance is a separate owner action. PAYMENT_OBSERVED requires authentic financial/provider evidence and is not inferred from an invoice or accepted terms.
topology.delivery: SERVICE_DELIVERY_AUTHORIZED is independently gated by the applicable offering's start conditions. Payment is neither universally required nor universally sufficient for delivery authorization.

offering_boundaries.icv.governance-assessment.v1: No universal payment/deposit prerequisite documented; delivery/start authority must be separately admitted from accepted scope and authorized source handling.
offering_boundaries.icv.governance-boundary-validation.v1: Pilot/data-handling/runtime boundaries remain separate; accepted terms do not create production execution authority.
offering_boundaries.icv.admitted-code.v1: Assessment delivery cannot authorize deployment or production admission.
offering_boundaries.icv.steggate.v1: Preview/pilot delivery cannot promote unreleased source to production authority.
offering_boundaries.icv.stegcrm.v1: Managed pilot delivery cannot create CRM write-back/source authority.
offering_boundaries.icv.hydrasafe.v1: SOW explicitly contains execution/deposit/milestone semantics; only selected deliverables in executed proposal are included and operational/professional authorization remains separate.
offering_boundaries.icv.gp10-field-validation.v1: Written exact scope and fixed-fee/cost-plus amount are required before accepting payment; payment does not establish safety/regulatory/repair/release authority.
offering_boundaries.icv.governance-observatory.v1: Fee/schedule/support are separately quoted; delivery remains observation/evaluation support without execution authority.
offering_boundaries.icv.knowledgevault.v1: Pilot delivery requires bounded vault/install scope; provider/storage/synchronization authority remains separate.
offering_boundaries.icv.stegtalk.v1: Prototype demonstration only; payment/acceptance cannot create production transport/deployment authority.
offering_boundaries.icv.ecosystem-chat.v1: Preview delivery cannot create live distributed execution/provider entitlement.
offering_boundaries.icv.steglearn.v1: Pilot delivery remains bounded by parent/steward, privacy and review responsibilities.
